objective: Standard statement: the 122 rule shapes of SHARED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001A with arbitrary nonzero real weights on the knot's tuples, under shared subdivision at scale 2 and 3; exactness as in SIGNED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001A (F = c W on the tested coarse tori), support-exactness as the interference reading. Prove: (1) positivity: with positive weights F and W have the supports of the counted rule, so only the counted support-exact shapes (22 at scale 2, 6 at scale 3) can be exact; (2) a sign-parity obstruction: when every fine extension of a coarse-forbidden assignment uses each tuple the same number of times mod 2, F is nonzero there for every real weighting; census of the shapes it excludes (scale 2: coarse sides 2 and 3; scale 3: side 2), of what the per-sign-class refinement adds, and of the shapes left open; (3) the real exact weightings of the 22 shapes with affine solution sets, in a gauge slice over every sign class, at scale 2 on coarse sides 2 to 6 and at scale 3 on sides 2 to 4, using the explicit solution sets of SHARED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001B checked against exact counts; (4) exact algebra for the one-parameter cyclic families (parity, not-all-equal) and for the symmetric slices (weights constant on Hamming classes) of the open symmetric atoms on the coarse 2-torus. The real-weight search over the shapes left open moves to SIGNED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001C (an experiment), because a search cannot discharge a theorem. Nearest known result: SHARED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001A and B (counted); SIGNED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001A (signs); positivity of transfer matrices; stabilizer (quadratic-phase) states; exact decimation in two dimensions (rare). Classification: no overlap found (candidate local delta).
